$comment: Smooth LOD transitions (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.6 'Swaps'). fadeS: seconds a swap between detail levels cross-fades over: the outgoing and the incoming level both draw, each pixel showing exactly one of them by a stable screen-space threshold against the fade (0: swaps in a single frame, as before Phase 42). pattern: the threshold per pixel — bayer4 (a 4 × 4 ordered dither, 16 steps), bayer8 (8 × 8, 64 steps) or noise (interleaved gradient noise). coarsenRatio: hysteresis in the LOD selection; a section refines where its cells project larger than the pixel error and coarsens again only once they project smaller than the pixel error / coarsenRatio (and, within the full-detail distance, once it is coarsenRatio × that distance away), so sections don't flip-flop as the camera moves along a boundary (1: no hysteresis). Run `node shared/look/lodblend.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/lodblend.gen.rs is stale.
